facts.text: The resort is in Marbella's Valley of Golf and has a 27-hole golf course.
facts.excerpt: Ideally located in the "Valley of Golf", The Westin La Quinta Golf Resort & Spa, Benahavís, Marbella is a unique destination for golf lovers, with a 27-hole course

facts.text: The resort is surrounded by the Sierra Blanca mountains and the Mediterranean, 10 minutes by car from Marbella.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by the beautiful landscape of Sierra Blanca mountains and the Mediterranean Sea, this oasis of relaxation is only 10 minutes away by car from Marbella.

facts.text: La Quinta Golf & Country Club has three 9-hole championship courses designed by Manuel Piñero.
facts.excerpt: La Quinta Golf & Country Club boasts three 9-hole championship courses designed by Manuel Piñero.

facts.text: Puerto Banús marina is about 10 minutes away.
facts.excerpt: Guests are within easy reach from the vibrant Puerto Banús Marina Harbor, just 10 minutes

facts.text: Rooms have private terraces or balconies.
facts.excerpt: Private terraces and balconies offer captivating views across our 170 spacious hotel rooms in Benahavís, Marbella

facts.text: Panoramic Rooms look out over the pool, gardens and mountains from private terraces.
facts.excerpt: Classic and Deluxe Panoramic Rooms offer views of the pool, gardens, and mountains from private terraces

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a vast terrace with an outdoor whirlpool tub and sunbeds.
facts.excerpt: Its standout feature is the vast terrace, complete with an outdoor whirlpool tub, lounge zones, and sunbeds

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a private sauna.
facts.excerpt: it features a private sauna, indoor and outdoor whirlpool tubs

facts.text: The Heavenly Spa is designed in Moorish style and has a hydrotherapy pool.
facts.excerpt: Designed in Moorish style, the 1,500-square-meter Heavenly Spa by Westin™ comprises eight treatment rooms and one hydrotherapy pool.

facts.text: The Heavenly Spa is dedicated to the history of Andalusia.
facts.excerpt: Dedicated to the passion found throughout the history of Andalusia

facts.text: The spa has a Mediterranean sauna, an aromatic steam room, sensorial showers and an ice fountain.
facts.excerpt: a Mediterranean Sauna and Aromatic Steam Room, Cascade Showers, Two Sensorial Showers, an Ice Fountain

facts.text: The Clubhouse Restaurant & Bar has a large year-round terrace with panoramic golf course views.
facts.excerpt: The Clubhouse Restaurant & Bar comprises a restaurant, snack bar and cafe. Its large terrace can be enjoyed throughout the year and boasts wonderful panoramic views to the golf course.

facts.text: The Aljama Bar is the hotel's cocktail bar, with Arabic decor.
facts.excerpt: The Aljama Bar is the hotel cocktail bar by excellence, a warm welcoming space adorned with Arabic decor.

facts.text: The Kids Club, for children aged 4 to 12, opens only in July and August.
facts.excerpt: Available for children between 4 and 12 years old area. Opens exclusively in July and August

facts.text: An olive oil experience connects guests with the land and traditions of Andalusia.
facts.excerpt: Experience the essence of Andalusia with a journey designed to connect you with the land, its traditions, and the art of olive oil.

facts.text: Malaga Airport and a high-speed train station are 45 minutes away.
facts.excerpt: Malaga Airport (AGP) and a high-speed train station are 45 minutes away
